reweight._comment: Inverse-frequency reweighting. Per-sample loss weight w_g = N/(K*n_g) -- the importance ratio (1/K)/(n_g/N) that maps the natural group distribution onto the uniform one -- normalized within each batch. Every disease group then contributes equally in expectation. There are NO tuning knobs by design: the weights follow entirely from the group counts. training.weight_decay is the main knob for this baseline (reweighting needs regularization to beat ERM on worst-group error).
reweight._comment_allowed_disease_groups: Order = string-match PRIORITY (first match wins). Entries are a group name string, or {name, exclude:[terms]} where exclude terms VETO the match. Here Healthy absorbs e.g. 'Healthy Cardiotoxicity' but drops 'Healthy Pediatric' (excluded by 'Pediatric'). A more specific name must precede a broader one. Identical semantics to dro.allowed_disease_groups.

frame_validity._comment: set csv_path to this dataset's frame-counts CSV to mask padding frames in the loss; null = off (all frames)
